title: Evolution and Competition for Resources (Abstract)
description: An abstracted model exploring how resource competition influences population evolution and can lead to overuse. Agents have different resource-consumption traits (sustainable/low harvest or greedy/high harvest), seek resource-rich patches, harvest for energy, expend energy to survive, and reproduce asexually with possible mutations.
